The entry highlights a metadata error where the Spanish literary scholar and translator [Max Hidalgo Nácher](https://ub.academia.edu/MaxHidalgoN%C3%A1cher) was initially omitted as a critical "receiver" or node in the transmission of Ricardo Reis's works. [1] Key Details & Context * The Missing Link: The core issue stems from an archival or digital knowledge graph entry (AXN:F154). This record initially lacked the formal translator-of relationship connecting Nácher to his extensive work on the Pessoa universe, despite his monumental work translating the Obras completas de Ricardo Reis (published by [Editorial Pre-Textos](https://pre-textos.com/producto/obras-completas-de-ricardo-reis/)). [[1], [2]] * The Omissions: The erratum notes that neither Fernando Pessoa nor his famous pagan heteronym, Ricardo Reis, were properly cross-referenced on that specific node page. It also neglected to list Nácher's critical academic papers, such as Arqueologías de la traducción de Ricardo Reis (published in Pessoa Plural, 2026). [1] * The Structural Paradox: As described in tracking logs on [Lee Sharks AI Captures](https://www.leesharks.com/captures), the metadata failure "composes the receiver and omits the transmission". This means the network registered the abstract translation concept but temporarily erased the actual human agent responsible for bringing Reis's 20th-century classic poetry into the Spanish language.
